headline: Advancing Quantum Hardware, Codes, and Simulation
summary: Today's collection explores the frontiers of quantum information science, ranging from novel hardware dissipation techniques and error-correcting codes to quantum algorithms for open-system simulation and the generalization limits of quantum generative models. Together, these works highlight both the power and the subtle pitfalls of designing quantum architectures and protocols.

themes.title: Quantum Simulation and Generative Models
themes.body: New frameworks tackle open quantum system dynamics in heavy-ion collisions using pseudomodes, while empirical tests reveal that quantum generative models trained with moment-matching struggle with generalization compared to likelihood-trained ones.

themes.title: Quantum Error Correction and Hardware
themes.body: Researchers investigate bosonic codes on genus-two Riemann surfaces using automorphic forms, engineer multi-photon dissipation via a dc-voltage-biased SQUID for cat-qubit stabilization, and explore zero-modes in constrained Rydberg chains.

themes.title: Quantum Cryptography
themes.body: An innovative protocol achieves unconditional certified randomness in the quantum random oracle model against adaptive subexponential quantum queries without requiring underlying structure.
